description: This file contains a mock implementation of the ILocalGrainDirectory interface for unit testing within the Orleans project. It primarily provides methods to simulate unregistering grains and tracking related metrics, with several unimplemented methods throwing exceptions.

classes.name: MockLocalGrainDirectory
classes.description: A mock class implementing ILocalGrainDirectory for testing purposes. It simulates unregistration logic and tracks calls, delays, and received unregister requests.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal counters and received registration list.

methods.name: UnregisterAsync
methods.description: Simulates unregistering a single grain address with a delay.

methods.name: UnregisterManyAsync
methods.description: Simulates unregistering multiple grain addresses with a batch delay.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Method intended to start the directory, not implemented.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Method intended to stop the directory asynchronously, not implemented.
